project_type: Local in-process Strands fashion agent (Claude Sonnet 4.5 brain) + Streamlit UI; CDK provisions only the S3 + S3 Vectors data plane. No managed Bedrock agent runtime.
build_system: hatchling (PEP 517). No compile step; package is 'components'. Quirk: frontend/ is NOT a package in pyproject wheel targets but is imported as 'frontend.app' from the repo root during tests/import-safety; run commands from the worktree root.
test_framework: pytest + pytest-mock (dev extra). Everything mocked, no real AWS/network (NFR-5). Fixtures in tests/conftest.py (FakeSettings, FakeS3, RecordingBedrock, embedding_response, image_response, png_b64).
build_command: No separate build. Sanity: python -c "import frontend.app" (must NOT execute Streamlit page code).
test_command: python3 -m pytest -q   (run from the worktree root; testpaths=tests)
verification_instructions: 1) Import-safety gate: `python -c "import frontend.app"` must print nothing/no error and must NOT run page code (all page code lives in run_app() under `if __name__ == "__main__"`). 2) Unit gate: `python3 -m pytest -q` from the worktree root — baseline is 35 passed; must stay green plus any added tests. Do NOT run `streamlit run`, do NOT call real AWS, do NOT run `cdk deploy`.
environment_constraints: WORK ONLY in /Users/erictole/demo/fashion-assistant-agent/.worktrees/frontend-modern-ux (relative paths land in the parent workspace). Use `git -C /Users/erictole/demo/fashion-assistant-agent/.worktrees/frontend-modern-ux` for git. Branch frontend-modern-ux. Installed: streamlit 1.60.0 (NOTE: brief said 1.65.0; actual is 1.60.0 — both st.status and st.dialog exist, but gate every use on hasattr with a graceful fallback), strands-agents 1.23.0, boto3 1.43.107, Pillow, pyyaml. No new heavy dependencies; no external/network fonts.
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md: focus the diff on the specific change, do not reformat unrelated code, ensure local tests pass before submitting. Commit locally on the branch with clear messages; never push.
key_patterns: Tools return the native Strands ToolResult envelope via _result.ok()/not_found()/err(): {"status":"success|error","content":[{"json":{...}}]}. status is ONLY success|error; a recoverable miss is status=success with nested result="not_found". ToolResultCollector (hooks.py) is a HookProvider on AfterToolCallEvent recording (tool_name, result) pairs; latest_ok_s3_uri() scans newest-first for an ok payload with non-null s3_uri. Pure helpers (build_upload_key, build_s3_uri, build_handoff, normalize_image, TraceCollector, INIT_MESSAGE) are at module scope in frontend/app.py with NO Streamlit side effects; ALL page code is inside run_app(). settings via load_settings() -> frozen Settings (primary_region, image_region, embedding_region, image_bucket, vector_bucket, vector_index, top_k=3). Never hardcode regions/bucket/index. Vector metadata carries BOTH s3_uri AND name (s3vectors_ingest.ipynb writes {"s3_uri": catalog_uri, "name": name}).
